title: TC-TIB-016 — [Edge] Switch source category → inline after save
steps:
Preconditions: Global Option (Additional Option, source = Select from category), already saved

  1. Re-open the Global Option
  2. Try switching source to Create new
  3. If allowed, switch back to Select from category
expectedResult: Switching source shows a warning dialog first. After confirming, Default value is cleared; the previous category selection is kept in the background. Switching back to Select from category restores that exact category selection (confirmed by dev comment).
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, store linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com. GO 987 (category-sourced Additional Option, category "Source additional option", items 1/2/3), already saved.

Observed (direct): Clicked "Create new" on the saved category-sourced GO. A confirm dialog appeared: "Change additional option source? Customizations and orders already made with this global option point to the items of the current source. After switching, they will no longer match the new items. Items of the current source are kept, so you can switch back later." Confirmed with "Switch source". Result: Default value field was cleared (showed only "Show option to select default value", no selected value). The inline item list showed "Additional Options (1)" with "Placeholder item" — this is the original inline item from when this GO was first created in TC-002 before ever switching to category source; it had been kept in the background the whole time.

Switched back to "Select from category" — same warning dialog appeared again, confirmed. Result: the category selection was restored exactly as it was — "Selected: Source additional option" with items 1, 2, 3 shown in both the category list and the Preview panel.

Conclusion (direct observation): All parts of expected result verified — warning dialog before switching, Default value cleared, previous data (inline items, in this direction) kept in the background, and switching back restores the exact prior category selection.
